purpose: Construct a candidate-independent Reference numerical self-disagreement envelope for the prospectively selected upper top-flux admissibility-boundary probe before any new RossFast execution at the inside/outside boundary offsets.

contract_derived_boundary.rationale: 0.009 is 0.001 inside, 0.010 is the exact request-side upper production boundary, and 0.011 is 0.001 outside. These values are derived from the frozen production contract rather than from candidate outcomes.

matrix.materials: all 36 D3R materials B01-B18 and O01-O18

reference_only_method.comparison: one Reference solve over 0.0064 day versus two sequential Reference solves over 0.0032 + 0.0032 day

threshold_rule.statistic: maximum Reference self-disagreement over all 36 materials x all three contract-derived top-flux probe factors in the exact Se stratum

known_candidate_information_boundary.exact_boundary_0p010: Previously observed in P2E10/P2E15 continuity cases and is not untreated holdout.
known_candidate_information_boundary.inside_0p009: No publication-oriented RossFast outcome inspected before this preregistration.
known_candidate_information_boundary.outside_0p011: No publication-oriented RossFast outcome inspected before this preregistration.
known_candidate_information_boundary.implication: The later E2 candidate experiment must distinguish continuity evidence at 0.010 from new boundary evidence at 0.009 and 0.011.

outcome_policy.if_all_324_reference_pairs_valid: Persist fifteen E2 Reference thresholds and authorize a separate RossFast boundary probe.
outcome_policy.if_any_reference_pair_invalid: Persist blocked Reference-domain result and do not execute the new RossFast boundary probe.
